name: Alitzah Wiener
office: Hacienda La Puente Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5

items.text: Alitzah Navarro Wiener is a children's educator and entertainer and a candidate for the Hacienda La Puente Unified School District board, Trustee Area 5. She serves as vice president of the Hacienda Heights Improvement Association.

sentences.text: Alitzah Navarro Wiener is a children's educator and entertainer and a candidate for the Hacienda La Puente Unified School District board, Trustee Area 5.
She serves as vice president of the Hacienda Heights Improvement Association.

items.text: Navarro Wiener says restoring trust and transparency is the district's first urgent need. She says the board should focus on governing and listen to educators, parents, and staff. She wants the district to learn why families transfer out and to improve programs and campus environments accordingly. She also proposes evaluating bilingual teaching assistant staffing and expanding social media in Chinese and Spanish. She supports creating a shared performing arts center for all schools.
